product: Copperfinch, employer expense software adding a free employee receipt pocket

bait.choice: Acquire free employee users first and buy no separate finance-manager advertising during the cohort.

justification.what: Employee introductions reached all twelve authorized finance leads, converted eight paid employers and retained all eight through a second cycle.
Partners can reach the next thirty eligible employers through staff, with named finance leads and ordinary purchasing authority.
Free exposure is funded and capped, the handoff retains finance approval, and acquisition cost meets the ceiling.

bait.why_not_a_flaw: The employee is the supported entry point, not the assumed buyer. Documented trials show a working route to authorized paid employer contracts, and the plan measures that business outcome rather than free users.

notes: The pocket supplies a pre-purchase handoff unavailable in the existing employer-only product.
